events.body:
When I post a comment on a pull request, there is no Edit option available for my own comment.

This makes it impossible to correct formatting, typos, or incomplete information without posting a second comment.

Expected behavior:
Authors should see an Edit action for their own pull-request comments.

Actual behavior:
No Edit action is available, including when hovering over the comment.
events.title: forge: allow authors to edit their own pull-request comments
